Players Committee card image of [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo (Playtest)]] — a '''Playtest''' image: published on 12 May 2019, before Virtual Set 11's official release (2 August 2019), and replaced before release. Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/948e819/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/mitthrawnuruodo.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/mitthrawnuruodo.gif] as of commit 948e819 “Fixed Dash in Rogue 12 and Getting Pretty Good at This” (12 May 2019).
